exposure: Fetuses with abnormal intrapartum fetal heart rate
Fetuses with intrapartum fetal scalp pH <7.20 requiring cesarean section
Neonates with postpartum admission to neonatal or pediatric intensive care units
cohort: 569 non-small fetuses attending the day hospital unit of a tertiary hospital, undergoing ultrasound examination at 36-40 weeks gestation, and delivered within 4 weeks of examination
finding: CPR alone had limited accuracy for predicting IFC, and its predictive value was not significantly improved by the addition of other perinatal parameters.
mod_finding: This study found that intrapartum fetal compromise (IFC) occurred in a proportion of fetuses growing over the 10th centile and that cerebroplacental ratio (CPR) had some predictive accuracy for IFC, but did not specifically analyze mode of delivery.
